descriptions.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向§H虚境§!深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the §HShroud§! and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

descriptions.zh: §H虚空之低语§!渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
descriptions.en: The §HWhisperers in the Void§! yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

descriptions.zh:
§H世界之喰煞§!向我们释放出了暴怒。虚境隧道在[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName]恒星系现身，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]能[GetFeelLoc]到我们前超主的怨恨正在快速袭来。

我们必须做好自我保护的准备。
descriptions.en:
The §HEater of Worlds§! has unleashed its furious wrath upon us. A Shroud Tunnel has emerged in the [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName] system, and our [GetTelepathPlural] can [GetFeelLoc] the fast-approaching malice of our former patron.

We must prepare to defend ourselves.

The §HInstrument of Desire§! has unleashed its furious wrath upon us. A Shroud Tunnel has emerged in the [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName] system, and our [GetTelepathPlural] can [GetFeelLoc] the fast-approaching malice of our former patron.

We must prepare to defend ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
§H生命之织缕§!向我们释放出了暴怒。虚境隧道在[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName]恒星系现身，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]能[GetFeelLoc]到我们前超主的怨恨正在快速袭来。

我们必须做好自我保护的准备。
descriptions.en:
The §HComposer of Strands§! has unleashed its furious wrath upon us. A Shroud Tunnel has emerged in the [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName] system, and our [GetTelepathPlural] can [GetFeelLoc] the fast-approaching malice of our former patron.

We must prepare to defend ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
整个星系受到了一个具有无比强大力量的实体的威胁，它被称为§R最终清算§!。它由纯能量构成，突然显现以来开始了一趟破坏之旅。

所有数据都表明该物体与我们之前见过的一切事物都截然不同。如果我们想应对这个威胁，就必须进行紧急研究来弄明白到底应该如何与之一战。
descriptions.en:
The galaxy is under threat from an immensely powerful entity known as the §RReckoning§!. Composed of pure energy, it materialized suddenly and began a campaign of destruction.

All available data indicate that this being is an opponent unlike anything we have faced before. If we wish to confront this threat, we should execute emergency research to determine more effective methods of engagement.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们没能成功，但直面§R最终清算§!也给我们的研究带来了宝贵的数据。

将研究精力投入到该神秘能量生物上，我们就能找到它的弱点，从而发展出更有效的攻击手段。
descriptions.en:
Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the §RReckoning§! provided invaluable data for study.

By dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop more effective methods of attack.

descriptions.zh: §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!做好了灵潜仪式的一切必要准备工作，随时可以代我们进入§H虚境§!。他们能为我们寻得何种洞见仍不得而知。
descriptions.en: The §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§! have made the necessary preparations to perform a Delving Ritual and reach into the §HShroud§! on our behalf. Whatever insights they will guide us to are uncertain.

descriptions.zh: §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的灵能辐射等级突然提升，甚至在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上都能感受到这种效应。我们必须近距离研究这种不断恶化的现象，不能再让它威胁到我们的人口了。
descriptions.en: Levels of psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system have suddenly increased, and the effects are being felt on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. We must study this developing phenomenon up close before it further endangers our population.

descriptions.zh: 我们祖先建造在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!的§H远古堡场§!是用来保护我们不受灵能辐射伤害的。§H灵能光环§!的入侵大大超出了它的防护能力。如果用上目前为止所学到的知识，我们应该就有能力提升其防御性能。
descriptions.en: The §HAncient Ward§! built by our ancestors on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of §HPsionic Auras§! threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what we have learned so far, we should be able to enhance its resistant properties.

descriptions.zh: 在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的梦客圣所遗迹里，我们找到了一颗被紧紧包裹着的“茧”，它正在散发出极高等级的灵能辐射。我们必须进行现场调查来消除这个物体可能带来的威胁。
descriptions.en: Within the ruined Sanctum of the Dreamer on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!, we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any threat this object might pose.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经做好了成立独立的§H“灵督城邦”§!以协助结束星系中灵能侵染行动的准备。

一旦成立，该机构可以为需要的人提供反灵能服务，并以此为我们赚取收入和物资。
descriptions.en:
We are prepared to construct an independent §H'Mindwarden Enclave'§! to further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.

Once constructed, this facility can provide anti-psionic services for those who need them, while providing us a portion of the revenue and materials it receives.

descriptions.zh:
§H虚境§!中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
descriptions.en:
The entities within the §HShroud§! are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

descriptions.zh:
长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与我们[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。

如果我们想理解这个现象，就必须去探索[exiled_system_border.GetName]系。
descriptions.en:
Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with irregular readings produced by our Ancient Ward on [owner.GetHomeWorldName].

If we wish to understand this phenomenon, we must explore [exiled_system_border.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上发现的灵能碎片蕴藏着诸多必须破解的奥秘。

阻碍我们的正是自身思维的局限。
descriptions.en:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上发现的灵能碎片蕴藏着诸多必须破解的奥秘。

阻碍我们的正是自身思维的局限。
descriptions.en:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入§H虚境§!之中，让§R心声§!强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
descriptions.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the §HShroud§! and force the staggering power of the §RVoice§! to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now, it will reveal its true name to us, and with that knowledge we will achieve greatness.
